points.title: 童年教育
points.description: 约翰·斯图尔特·穆勒出生于伦敦，是著名哲学家詹姆斯·穆勒的儿子。从幼年起，他就接受了极其严格和系统化的教育，由父亲亲自指导。穆勒3岁开始学习希腊语，8岁学习拉丁语，12岁已阅读了柏拉图、亚里士多德等古典哲学家的原作。这种高强度教育使他智力早熟但也导致他青少年时期经历严重的精神危机。这段经历对他后来的哲学思想产生了深远影响，使他开始质疑功利主义的简单形式。
points.descriptionEn: John Stuart Mill was born in London to James Mill, a prominent philosopher. From an early age, he received an extremely rigorous and systematic education under his father's direct guidance. Mill began studying Greek at age 3, Latin at 8, and by 12 had read original works by classical philosophers like Plato and Aristotle. This intensive education made him intellectually precocious but also led to a severe mental crisis during his adolescence. This experience profoundly influenced his later philosophical thinking, causing him to question the simplistic forms of utilitarianism.

points.title: 哲学启蒙
points.description: 1821年，穆勒前往爱丁堡学习，开始接触法国思想家孔德和圣西门的实证主义思想。这一时期，他深入研究边沁的功利主义哲学，并开始发展自己的思想体系。1823年，穆勒加入东印度公司，开始了他长达35年的公务员生涯。在爱丁堡期间，穆勒还结识了重要的思想伙伴，包括历史学家托马斯·巴宾顿·麦考利，这些交流极大地丰富了他的思想视野，使他开始将功利主义与自由主义思想相结合。
points.descriptionEn: In 1821, Mill traveled to Edinburgh to study and began engaging with the positivist ideas of French thinkers Comte and Saint-Simon. During this period, he deeply studied Jeremy Bentham's utilitarian philosophy and began developing his own philosophical system. In 1823, Mill joined the East India Company, beginning his 35-year career as a civil servant. In Edinburgh, Mill also met important intellectual companions, including historian Thomas Babington Macaulay, whose exchanges greatly broadened his intellectual perspective and led him to combine utilitarianism with liberal thought.

points.title: 思想转型
points.description: 回到伦敦后，穆勒经历了深刻的思想危机和个人转变。1826年，他陷入严重的精神抑郁，开始质疑功利主义是否能真正指导道德生活。这一时期，他阅读了华兹华斯、柯勒律治等浪漫主义诗人的作品，以及柏拉图和亚里士多德的哲学，这些阅读帮助他重新思考了功利主义的局限性。1830年，穆勒完成了《论自由》的初稿，这部作品后来成为自由主义思想的经典之作。这一时期，他还与哈丽特·泰勒建立了深厚的友谊，后者对他的思想产生了重要影响。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to London, Mill experienced a profound intellectual crisis and personal transformation. In 1826, he fell into severe depression and began questioning whether utilitarianism could truly guide moral life. During this period, he read works by Romantic poets like Wordsworth and Coleridge, as well as the philosophy of Plato and Aristotle, which helped him reconsider the limitations of utilitarianism. By 1830, Mill had completed the first draft of 'On Liberty', which later became a classic of liberal thought. During this time, he also formed a deep friendship with Harriet Taylor, who significantly influenced his thinking.

points.title: 思想成熟
points.description: 这一时期是穆勒思想成熟和创作的高峰期。1836年，他发表了《论政治经济学中若干未解决的问题》，开始发展自己的经济思想。1843年，他出版了《逻辑体系》，这部著作对归纳逻辑和科学方法产生了深远影响。1848年，他发表了《政治经济学原理》，这部著作成为19世纪中期经济学的重要教科书。1851年，穆勒与哈丽特·泰勒结婚，两人共同致力于社会改革。这一时期，穆勒积极参与各种社会活动，包括妇女选举权运动，他的思想逐渐从纯粹的功利主义转向更加关注个人自由和社会正义的综合立场。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the peak of Mill's intellectual maturity and creativity. In 1836, he published 'Essays on Some Unsettled Questions of Political Economy', beginning to develop his economic thought. In 1843, he published 'A System of Logic', which had a profound influence on inductive logic and scientific methods. In 1848, he published 'Principles of Political Economy', which became an important economics textbook in the mid-19th century. In 1851, Mill married Harriet Taylor, and together they worked on social reform. During this time, Mill actively participated in various social movements, including women's suffrage, and his thinking gradually shifted from pure utilitarianism to a more comprehensive stance that emphasized both individual liberty and social justice.

points.title: 晚年影响
points.description: 1859年，穆勒出版了《论自由》，这部著作确立了他在自由主义思想史上的重要地位。1863年，他发表了《功利主义》，系统阐述了他对功利主义的新理解。1865-1868年，穆勒担任英国下议院议员，积极推动议会改革、妇女选举权和教育改革。1865年，他发表了《关于议会改革的思考》，提出了扩大选举权的具体方案。晚年，穆勒移居法国阿维尼翁，继续写作和思考。1873年，穆勒在阿维尼翁逝世，他的思想对后来的自由主义、社会民主主义和女权主义产生了深远影响，成为19世纪最重要的政治哲学家之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1859, Mill published 'On Liberty', establishing his important place in the history of liberal thought. In 1863, he published 'Utilitarianism', systematically articulating his new understanding of utilitarianism. From 1865 to 1868, Mill served as a Member of Parliament, actively promoting parliamentary reform, women's suffrage, and educational reform. In 1865, he published 'Considerations on Representative Government', proposing specific plans for expanding suffrage. In his later years, Mill moved to Avignon, France, continuing to write and reflect. Mill died in Avignon in 1873. His thought had a profound influence on later liberalism, social democracy, and feminism, making him one of the most important political philosophers of the 19th century.

supporter.zh: 穆勒被视为自由主义思想的奠基人之一，他的《论自由》为个人自由与国家权力的边界提供了经典论述。支持者赞扬他将功利主义与自由主义相结合的尝试，认为这种结合既关注最大多数人的幸福，又保护少数派和个人的权利。穆勒对妇女权利和教育改革的倡导，体现了他对社会正义的深切关怀。他的思想为现代民主社会提供了重要的理论基础，影响了从自由市场到社会福利政策的广泛领域。
supporter.en: Mill is regarded as one of the founders of liberal thought, and his 'On Liberty' provides a classic discussion on the boundaries between individual liberty and state power. Supporters praise his attempt to combine utilitarianism with liberalism, arguing that this combination both concerns the happiness of the greatest number and protects the rights of minorities and individuals. Mill's advocacy for women's rights and educational reform reflects his deep concern for social justice. His thought has provided important theoretical foundations for modern democratic societies, influencing a wide range of areas from free markets to social welfare policies.

critic.zh: 批评者指出穆勒的思想存在内在矛盾，尤其是他的功利主义与自由主义原则之间的张力。有学者认为他的'伤害原则'在实践中难以明确界定，可能导致对个人自由的过度干预。穆勒对精英统治的倾向也受到批评，他在《论自由》中暗示受过良好教育的人应该对大众拥有更大的影响力。此外，穆勒对殖民主义的辩护态度也受到现代后殖民主义学者的质疑，认为这与他的自由主义立场相矛盾。
critic.en: Critics point out that Mill's thought contains internal contradictions, particularly the tension between his utilitarian and liberal principles. Some scholars argue that his 'harm principle' is difficult to define in practice, potentially leading to excessive interference with individual liberty. Mill's tendency toward elitism has also been criticized, as he suggested in 'On Liberty' that the well-educated should have greater influence over the masses. Additionally, Mill's defense of colonialism has been questioned by modern postcolonial scholars, who argue it contradicts his liberal stance.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，穆勒被定位为19世纪最重要的政治哲学家之一，他的思想对现代民主制度产生了深远影响。学术界普遍认为穆勒代表了自由主义从古典向现代转型的关键人物，他试图调和功利主义与个人自由，为社会改革提供了理论基础。在流行文化中，穆勒常被引用为言论自由和思想自由的象征，他的'少数派权利'观点在当代多元文化社会中仍具有重要参考价值。穆勒的思想遗产跨越了政治、经济、伦理等多个领域，持续影响着当代关于个人自由与社会责任的讨论。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Mill is positioned as one of the most important political philosophers of the 19th century, whose thought has had a profound impact on modern democratic institutions. Academia generally regards Mill as a key figure in the transition from classical to modern liberalism, attempting to reconcile utilitarianism with individual liberty and providing theoretical foundations for social reform. In popular culture, Mill is often cited as a symbol of freedom of speech and thought, and his views on minority rights continue to hold significant reference value in contemporary multicultural societies. Mill's intellectual legacy spans multiple fields including politics, economics, and ethics, continuing to influence contemporary discussions about individual liberty and social responsibility.

self.zh: 唯一值得拥有自由的理由，是人们能够借此改进自己。
self.en: The only freedom which deserves the name is that of pursuing our own good in our own way.

others.zh: 穆勒是功利主义传统的伟大修正者，他试图将功利主义与自由主义原则相结合，为现代自由主义奠定了基础。
others.en: Mill was the great reviser of the utilitarian tradition, attempting to combine utilitarianism with liberal principles and laying the foundation for modern liberalism.
